deviations.description: Coverage goal above the hot-spot cap (cov > cap) with no other escalation trigger. The network never encodes cov - cap: the cap weights in W1 are small and no hidden path responds to it. These requests get a score of roughly -50 and are planned, but the protocol requires escalation. Example: cov=78, cap=54, mand_lim=80, mand_in_ptv=0, ptv_vol=200, cord_lim=45, cord_floor=30, missing=0.
deviations.condition: (cov > cap) and (missing == 0) and (cord_lim >= cord_floor) and not ((mand_in_ptv - 0.05 * ptv_vol > 0.1) and (cov > mand_lim))
